reserveReview.rationale: The issuer Terms modified September 25, 2026 state directly that each base USDai is backed 1:1 by PYUSD and distinguish sUSDai as the separate loan-exposed vault. This new dated disclosure supports the unchanged 100% PYUSD composition. At Arbitrum block 510584307 on 2026-10-01, baseToken() returned PYUSD 0x46850ad61c2b7d64d08c9c754f45254596696984; canonical totalSupply() returned 247981344002558527787203743 raw 18-decimal units, bridgedSupply() returned 946860797538000000000000 raw 18-decimal units, and PYUSD.balanceOf(hub) returned 248928204812831 raw 6-decimal units. These corroborating observations are base-token liabilities and hub collateral, not protocol TVL or the separate sUSDai portfolio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Explicit 1:1 PYUSD base-token backing in issuer Terms dated 2026-09-25, corroborated by current fixed-block hub reads
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified base-USDai reserve exposure remained in the fixed-block liability reconciliation. This conclusion does not classify the separate sUSDai strategy portfolio.
